observations.evidence: RPC accepted get_state and was terminated with SIGTERM after command completion.
get_state returned a persisted fixture sessionFile and sessionId.
SessionManager.list(fixtureCwd, fixtureSessionDir) returned two synthetic durable sessions with metadata fields id,path,cwd,name,messageCount.
switch_session accepted a fixture session path.
get_messages, get_entries, and get_tree returned successful structured responses.
fork on synthetic user entry abc12345 returned cancelled:false.
clone on an independently opened synthetic one-message session returned cancelled:false.
set_session_name succeeded; later get_state returned fixture-session.
export_html failed before an assistant conversation with: Nothing to export yet - start a conversation first.
delete_session returned success:false, error: Unknown command: delete_session. Upstream documents interactive picker deletion using trash when available.
switch_session to a nonexistent fixture path returned success:true, cancelled:false; adapter must prevalidate existence instead of treating RPC success as reopen proof.
switch_session to invalid JSONL returned success:false with a sanitized invalid-session error.
A CLI extension resources_discover hook emitted setStatus before normal command handling.
Synthetic extension emitted and received responses for select, confirm, input, editor, notify, setStatus, setWidget, setTitle, and set_editor_text.

contradictionsAndCorrections.correction: The bridge must check its stored Pi session reference exists and is a regular readable file before spawning/switching; Pi RPC success alone is insufficient.
M12 must implement deletion through a separately tested adapter path; it cannot map to a nonexistent Pi RPC delete command.
